item.title: Starting the blog
item.dc:creator: Milad
item.description:
Posts published on this site are the original versions. dev.to imports them from the RSS feed and points the canonical URL back here.

New posts are Markdown files in content/posts. A pull request builds a preview of the site, including drafts, before anything is merged. Set draft to false when a post should go live.

More about how the site is put together is on the about page .
